posts.author: Xaine
posts.body:
Hello, my name is Prince Xaine. In the last couple years I have been pouring my effort and attention into scripting. Long story short, I worked with a friend at a Spectrum call center and he introduced me to my first language in computer programming, Autohotkey. Turned out, that I absolutely
love
scripting. I went on to develop several programs in the language for the company, which are probably still used to this day. I got laid off last year, so I've been turning my attention elsewhere.
Since my separation from the company, I decided to learn Javascript. After some time, I realized I could use this language to create a plugin(s) for RPG Maker MZ. Having recently played through Expedition 33, I ended up creating what you see in the image. The idea is that you are able to dodge or parry enemy skills.
How it works:
Attach notetags to skills to determine various settings such as the parry window timing, dodge window timing, the "too early" window, the number of hits and so on.
You then can press the parry button during the parry window to block all damage and attack back, or press the dodge button to dodge the attack.
I'm sharing an image because the plugin still needs work. I redesigned the QTE interface as it was very simple and I made it when I first started scripting for MZ. Having learned a lot I designed a better looking one. Once I'm happy with it, I'll probably just allow people to use it for free, was curious what people thought about the design in the meantime.
